title: F5 fix round 2: rebase the F5 branch onto goal/T-0240 (35c0462, F7) so its gate stops failing on the sqlite ResourceWarning flake; no code change
spec:
Your worktree is cut from task/T-0254 (commits 9c7a7a0 "Fix Codex resume sandbox argv reporting" over f4aeb07 "Fix Codex resume argv handling", the F5 change plus its review fix; both approved in substance, review T-0251 asked only for the sandbox flag, which 9c7a7a0 adds). The daemon gate failed this branch three times on tests/test_handover.py::test_handover_survives_jev_exception because bus.db() leaked sqlite connections; that is fixed on goal/T-0240 by 35c0462 (F7), which this branch does not contain. The Planner may not rebase (planner-mode.sh), so you do it:
1. git fetch is not needed (same repo). Run: git rebase goal/T-0240 in the worktree. Resolve nothing by hand unless a conflict appears in orchestrator/executor.py or tests/test_executor.py; if one appears, keep both the F5 change and the goal side and say so in the final message.
2. Make no other edit. The diff of the branch against goal/T-0240 must be exactly the executor.py and tests/test_executor.py changes of the two F5 commits (git diff goal/T-0240 --stat shows only those two files).
3. Run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh . in the worktree until it exits 0 (run it twice; both must pass). Report both results and the new shas of the two rebased commits.
acceptance: git merge-base --is-ancestor goal/T-0240 HEAD succeeds in the worktree and git log --oneline -3 shows the two F5 commits above 35c0462
git diff goal/T-0240 --stat lists only orchestrator/executor.py and tests/test_executor.py

tests/test_executor.py passes including test_resume_argv_translates_sandbox_to_config, test_resume_argv_keeps_bypass_flag, test_argv_error_logs_run_and_hint, test_resume_argv_has_no_C_flag_and_uses_cwd, test_exec_argv_unchanged, test_usage_error_does_not_count_round
.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree on two consecutive runs

Supersedes T-0254 and T-0249. Posted by hand.
